question: Using Guidewire's fiscal 2026 Form 10-K and its fiscal Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, what were the implied fiscal Q4 2026 (three months ended July 31, 2026) total revenue and GAAP operating margin?
grading: Computation: Q4 = FY2026 - nine months ended April 30, 2026. Revenue USD 411.1M (411,087K); GAAP income from operations USD 62.3M (62,318K); GAAP operating margin 15.16% (+/-0.3pp). Accept +/-0.5% on dollar figures. Fail if non-GAAP operating income (USD 111.3M, 27.1%) is used as the GAAP margin.
answer: Implied Q4 FY2026 revenue = 1,475,363 (FY2026) - 1,064,276 (nine months to April 30, 2026) = USD 411,087 thousand (USD 411.1 million). Implied GAAP income from operations = 149,874 - 87,556 = USD 62,318 thousand (USD 62.3 million). GAAP operating margin = 62,318 / 411,087 = 15.16% [H11-E1][H11-E2]. This matches the Q4 figures in the earnings release (revenue USD 411.1 million; GAAP income from operations USD 62.3 million) [H11-E3].
